name: Medial Meniscus Root Tear
definition: Tear of the medial meniscus root, often degenerative in middle-aged or older adults and biomechanically similar to meniscal loss.

typical: Possible sudden painful pop without major trauma

investigations.principle: MRI is preferred to identify root tear, extrusion and associated cartilage/OA.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Repair versus nonoperative care depends on OA severity, alignment, age and tissue quality.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Tear of the medial meniscus root, often degenerative in middle-aged or older adults and biomechanically similar to meniscal loss.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
